streaming.title: The Love Hypothesis
streaming.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

streaming.title: UNABOMBER
streaming.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

streaming.title: Backrooms
streaming.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

streaming.title: Project Hail Mary
streaming.overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

streaming.title: Drawn Together
streaming.overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

streaming.title: Doing Life
streaming.overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

streaming.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
streaming.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

streaming.title: You+Me - Against the World
streaming.overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

streaming.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
streaming.original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
streaming.overview: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

streaming.title: Rosebush Pruning
streaming.overview: When an American heir living in a luxurious Spanish villa decides to move in with his girlfriend, his departure triggers a family collapse as his brother uncovers the truth behind their mother's tragic death.

streaming.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
streaming.overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

streaming.title: The Death of Robin Hood
streaming.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

streaming.title: The Runner
streaming.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

streaming.title: The Last Sunrise
streaming.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

streaming.title: Facing El Chapo
streaming.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

streaming.title: Scary Movie
streaming.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

streaming.title: Strung
streaming.overview: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

streaming.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
streaming.overview: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

streaming.title: Michael
streaming.overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

streaming.title: The Wrecking Crew
streaming.overview: Estranged half-brothers Jonny and James reunite after their father's mysterious death. As they search for the truth, buried secrets reveal a conspiracy threatening to tear their family apart.

streaming.title: Livestream from Hell
streaming.overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

streaming.title: Masters of the Universe
streaming.overview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

streaming.title: Swapped
streaming.overview: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.

streaming.title: Hoppers
streaming.overview: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

streaming.title: Shelter
streaming.overview: A man living in self-imposed exile on a remote island rescues a young girl from a violent storm, setting off a chain of events that forces him out of seclusion to protect her from enemies tied to his past.

streaming.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
streaming.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

streaming.title: Mayday
streaming.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

streaming.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
streaming.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

streaming.title: GOAT
streaming.overview: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

streaming.title: War Machine
streaming.overview: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

streaming.title: The Whisper Man
streaming.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

streaming.title: In the Grey
streaming.overview: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

streaming.title: Scream 7
streaming.overview: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

streaming.title: Greenland 2: Migration
streaming.overview: Having found the safety of the Greenland bunker after the comet Clarke decimated the Earth, the Garrity family must now risk everything to embark on a perilous journey across the wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

streaming.title: Vishwanath & Sons
streaming.overview: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

streaming.title: The Sheep Detectives
streaming.overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

streaming.title: Crime 101
streaming.overview: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

streaming.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
streaming.original_title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
streaming.overview: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

streaming.title: The Last House
streaming.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

streaming.title: The Devil's Mouth
streaming.overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

streaming.title: Send Help
streaming.overview: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

streaming.title: Apex
streaming.overview: A grieving woman pushing her limits on a solo adventure in the Australian wild is ensnared in a twisted game with a cunning killer who thinks she's prey.

streaming.title: The Rip
streaming.overview: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.

streaming.title: Seven Snipers
streaming.overview: When a former elite sniper is hunted down by the ruthless warlord who once held her captive, she must fight to the death to protect the daughter she has raised in hiding, on a remote Australian farm.

streaming.title: The Bride!
streaming.overview: A lonely Frankenstein travels to 1930s Chicago to ask groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious to create a companion for him. The two revive a murdered young woman and The Bride is born. But what ensues is beyond what either of them imagined.

streaming.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
streaming.overview: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

streaming.title: Pretty Lethal
streaming.overview: A troupe of ballerinas find themselves fighting for survival as they attempt to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

streaming.title: Return to Silent Hill
streaming.overview: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

streaming.title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
streaming.original_title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
streaming.overview: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

streaming.title: The Desert Child
streaming.overview: 14-year-old Sun has written and successfully published a story based on an incredible story told by her late grandfather about a wild child called Hadara, who is saved by a group of ostriches when he becomes separated from his family in a storm, and is then raised in the desert amid a host of wild animals, including his best friend, a desert fox. When Sun is invited to travel to the Sahara by a local community who has heard about her book, she meets Kharouba, a Nomad girl of her own age, and realizes there may be much more to Hadara than just a character in a bedtime story.

streaming.title: “Wuthering Heights”
streaming.overview: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

streaming.title: Normal
streaming.overview: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

streaming.title: Vengeance
streaming.overview: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.

streaming.title: undertone
streaming.overview: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way.

streaming.title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
streaming.overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

streaming.title: Desire
streaming.overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

streaming.title: Jackass: Best and Last
streaming.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

streaming.title: The Breadwinner
streaming.overview: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

streaming.title: Black Box
streaming.overview: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

streaming.title: Over Your Dead Body
streaming.overview: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to "reconnect", but each has secret intentions to kill the other.

upcoming.title: Bokshi
upcoming.overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

upcoming.title: Kitti
upcoming.overview: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

upcoming.title: Comrade Kalyan
upcoming.overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

upcoming.title: Chiram
upcoming.overview: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

upcoming.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
upcoming.overview: Carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Prabh's mistakes and carefree nature challenge Aavraj's rigid personality, while secretary Rajdeep becomes the bridge between them. As Prabh learns practicality from Aavraj, Rajdeep discovers joy and emotional freedom through Prabh. With Rajdeep's help, Prabh creates a fictional world to heal the misunderstanding between Aavraj and his estranged daughter. Their reunion restores Aavraj's happiness and brings him emotionally closer to Prabh. Touched by Prabh's spirit, Aavraj finally supports his startup dream, completing their transformative journey.

upcoming.title: All Pass
upcoming.overview: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

upcoming.title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
upcoming.overview: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

upcoming.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
upcoming.overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

upcoming.title: Jailer 2
upcoming.overview: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with the consequences of his actions against the antique mafia.

upcoming.title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
upcoming.overview: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

upcoming.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
upcoming.overview: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku is the much-awaited sequel to the 2024 all-time blockbuster Bohurupi, where Bikram and Jhimli return, stepping into a thrilling new chapter of adventure and high-stakes drama.

upcoming.title: Street Fighter
upcoming.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

upcoming.title: Nayyi Navelli
upcoming.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

upcoming.title: Ranabaali
upcoming.overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

upcoming.title: Prahaar - The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
upcoming.overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

upcoming.title: Clayface
upcoming.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

upcoming.title: Udta Teer
upcoming.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

upcoming.title: Border Diaries
upcoming.overview: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

upcoming.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
upcoming.overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

upcoming.title: Delivery Boy
upcoming.overview: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

upcoming.title: Magazine
upcoming.overview: Bored, privileged, and convinced his life has zero plot, a drama-hungry Gen Z cinephile leaves the city for his ancestral village in search of some main-character energy, hoping life will finally give him something worth talking about, but an unlikely friendship, a new world, and one unexpected twist soon turn his own life into the story he's been waiting for.

upcoming.title: Little Thomas
upcoming.overview: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.
